bannerPlacementGuide.title: How placements work
bannerPlacementGuide.introModel: Choose a <type>placement type</type> when you buy: <wide>wide</wide> (full row), <card>card</card> (one grid cell), or <left>left column</left> (rail beside the feed on desktop — on phones it appears at the bottom). Grey blocks are other profiles; the <violet>violet</violet> zone is your ad.
bannerPlacementGuide.introClub: Choose a <type>placement type</type> when you buy: <wide>wide</wide> (full row), <card>card</card> (one grid cell), or <left>left column</left> (rail beside the feed on desktop — on phones it appears at the bottom). Grey blocks are other profiles; the <violet>violet</violet> zone is your ad.
bannerPlacementGuide.introPagesModel: Your placements can appear on <home>Home</home>, <girls>Girls</girls> (<modelsPath>/models-page</modelsPath>), <clubs>Clubs</clubs>, <jobs>Jobs & Rent</jobs>, and similar browse views.
bannerPlacementGuide.introPagesClub: Your club’s placements can appear on <home>Home</home>, <girls>Girls</girls> (<modelsPath>/models-page</modelsPath>), <clubs>Clubs</clubs>, <jobs>Jobs & Rent</jobs>, and similar browse views.
bannerPlacementGuide.fairRotationBody: <semibold>Fair rotation:</semibold> For <wideLabel>wide</wideLabel> and <cardLabel>card</cardLabel> placements, when several banners are active, <emphasis>which one appears is randomised each load so exposure stays fair.</emphasis> <leftCol>Left-column</leftCol> inventory shows one rotated rail beside the feed on desktop; on mobile the inventory appears in the bottom strip.
